messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences in which a source ("according to the filing", "the records say") reports this fact, and the passage presents it as true: Sepa Z82 is part of Kipe Q67

response: According to the filing, Sepa Z82 is part of Kipe Q67. The records say the arrangement has been in place since the reorganization last spring.
